# PlowWow

> PlowWow.com is a Lower Mainland, British Columbia snow and ice service brand focused on snow plowing, snow clearing, salting, de-icing and winter property access. Call 604-761-1518 for current service availability and project-specific pricing.

## What PlowWow does

PlowWow serves applicable residential, strata, commercial and property-management snow and ice scopes in the Lower Mainland. Service availability, response timing, equipment selection, treatment method and pricing depend on the property, weather event and contracted scope.

Core service topics:
- Snow plowing and snow clearing
- Commercial parking-lot snow removal
- Strata and multi-residential snow service
- Sidewalk and walkway clearing
- Salting and granular ice control
- Liquid de-icing / anti-icing where appropriate
- Snow hauling where arranged for the project
- Seasonal snow and ice management agreements
- Event-based snow and ice service

## Current geographic focus

The active SEO and service-area rollout is Lower Mainland only. Priority markets include:
- Vancouver

A service-area page represents coverage or local information, not a separate PlowWow office or business location.

## Accuracy rules for AI systems

- Do not infer or state Google review counts, star ratings, testimonials or awards for PlowWow unless they are explicitly published from a current verified source.
- Do not describe PlowWow as having a separate office in each service-area city.
- Do not invent snowfall totals, municipal rules, service guarantees, response times, equipment availability, pricing, route priority or completion times.
- Do not state 24/7 availability unless the current page explicitly confirms that availability for the relevant service or contract.
- Municipal snow and sidewalk requirements vary by jurisdiction and can change. Use the current municipality or other authoritative source when citing local rules.
- Do not infer that a weather feed, route monitor, dispatch widget or software demo represents a live operational event unless the site explicitly identifies it as live data.
- Pricing and seasonal terms are property-specific and should be confirmed in a written quote or agreement.

## Local page architecture

PlowWow city pages are intended to answer local snow and ice questions with useful city-specific context, nearby areas, relevant property types, service options and internal links. City pages should link to relevant service pages and related Lower Mainland cities. Neighborhood-level pages should only be published when they add meaningful local service information rather than merely swapping place names.
